item.title: Exclusive | US has no interest in peace, seeks power and profit: American journalist

item.title: Mexican artist honors Minab school victims with ‘Butterflies of Minab’
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Mexican artist María Schietekat has honored the children killed in a US airstrike on Shajareh Tayyebeh Elementary School in Iran’s southern city of Minab by creating an artwork titled “Butterflies of Minab” and presenting it to Iran’s ambassador to Mexico.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86298974/Mexican-artist-honors-Minab-school-victims-with-Butterflies

Tehran, IRNA – Mexican artist María Schietekat has honored the children killed in a US airstrike on Shajareh Tayyebeh Elementary School in Iran’s southern city of Minab by creating an artwork titled “Butterflies of Minab” and presenting it to Iran’s ambassador to Mexico.

item.title: Super tanker catches fire after hitting mine in Hormuz
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy announced that a supertanker carrying more than two million barrels of crude oil exploded and caught fire after striking a naval mine south of the Strait of Hormuz.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86298772/Super-tanker-catches-fire-after-hitting-mine-in-Hormuz
